headline: IRENA Raises Renewable Energy Goal to 18.4 TW by 2035
summary: The International Renewable Energy Agency raised its renewable capacity target to 18.4 TW by 2035, noting that energy demand is rising faster than previously expected.
why: Adjusted global renewable energy targets guide long-term capital allocation toward clean energy infrastructure and grid expansion.

impacts.name: Clean Energy
impacts.why: Higher long-term capacity goals signal sustained policy support and investment demand for renewable infrastructure projects.
